name: Mobile app developer
summary: Builds and fixes iOS and Android app screens in React Native or Flutter. Handles loading, empty and offline states and older phones.

changelog.note: First release: 30 sources (App Store Review Guidelines of 16 Oct 2026, Apple privacy, deletion, TestFlight and phased release pages; Play target API, Data safety, testing tracks and staged rollouts; Android vitals, 16 KB pages, edge-to-edge, offline-first; RN 0.88, Expo SDK 58, Flutter 3.47). Three skills, five prompts, two workflows, training files.
